2026_05_CLE_NYJ.headline: Watson’s rookie receivers test Jets coverage as Graham’s absence opens a rushing lane
2026_05_CLE_NYJ.paragraph1: Cleveland enters MetLife Stadium on a three-game winning streak, with Deshaun Watson finding explosive gains through rookies Denzel Boston and KC Concepcion. The Jets’ cornerbacks have limited passing yardage, so tackling after the catch and handling Watson’s mobility are central challenges. New York needs Geno Smith to sustain drives after the Bears held its offense to just 32 plays. Cleveland’s injured defensive tackle Mason Graham leaves the Browns thinner inside, giving the Jets an opportunity to establish the run before facing Cleveland’s aggressive blitz packages.
2026_05_CLE_NYJ.model_rationale: Cleveland’s passing options threaten New York’s otherwise productive coverage, while the Jets need longer possessions and better rushing efficiency to exploit the Browns’ depleted interior defense.
